registryBasis: The official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs lists Butembo I and Butembo II as cadastral/land jurisdictions in Nord-Kivu. The government service catalogue documents formal consultation of cadastral and land registers through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre, with a paid request process. No open Butembo parcel map or anonymous parcel-geometry endpoint was verified.
blocker: No safe public parcel polygon or qualified anonymous parcel adapter was verified; runtime remains held.
